records.failureSummary: Implemented done-toggle and delete end-to-end for the TaskBoard frontend (AC-16/AC-17/AC-18). TaskItem now keeps data-done=\"true\"/\"false\" on the row (unchanged contract, normalized), renders native button task-done-toggle whose aria-pressed always mirrors the done state, and native button task-delete-button whose aria-label now includes the task title (\"删除任务：<title>\"); clicks only emit toggle/delete. useTaskStore exposes toggleDone(id) and removeTask(id) (toggle/remove kept as compatibility aliases): toggleDone clears the action error, flips done locally so data-done updates immediately, PATCHes /api/tasks/:id with {done}, overwrites the local item with the response task on 200 (so a refresh keeps the value), and on 404/non-2xx/network failure rolls back to the pre-click value and sets an action error instead of throwing; a per-id sequence guard prevents out-of-order PATCH responses from resurrecting/deleting stale state. removeTask calls DELETE /api/tasks/:id and removes the item from the source list on 204 AND on 404 (treated as success), so the task-item disappears and task-count (derived from source list length) decrements; other statuses keep the task and set an action error, never throwing. App.vue surfaces the new action error through the existing data-testid=\"error-banner\" (messages for load failure / save failure / toggle-delete failure) and clears it on retry and on the next successful operation. No backend, mock-server, dependency, lockfile, /__mock/* usage or external requests were touched. Verification: pnpm test = 185 tests, 184 passed, 1 failed; the single failure is the pre-existing, now-stale assertion in src/__tests__/task-toggle-delete.spec.ts:350 ('[AC-18] DELETE 返回 404 时静默降级：该项保留、task-count 不变') which directly contradicts the API spec / task description (\"204 或 404 均从源列表移除\"). I did not weaken, edit or delete that file; it must be updated by a separate TEST task. The QA-authored suites tests/toggle.spec.ts and tests/delete.spec.ts now pass 7/7 (previously 1 failed exactly on the 404 case). pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint and pnpm build all exit 0.
